issues.title: Prototype Pollution in tough-cookie
issues.description: Versions before 4.1.3 are vulnerable to Prototype Pollution via CookieJar.setCookie.

issues.title: Regular Expression Denial of Service in semver
issues.description: Versions before 7.5.2 are vulnerable to ReDoS via untrusted user input to the semver.satisfies() function.

issues.title: PostCSS line return parsing error
issues.description: Malformed CSS inputs can cause PostCSS to parse CSS strings incorrectly, leading to unexpected behavior.

issues.title: Prototype Pollution in loader-utils
issues.description: parseQuery() method may be vulnerable to prototype pollution via crafted query string inputs.

issues.title: Server-Side Request Forgery in request
issues.description: The request package is vulnerable to SSRF attacks due to improper input validation of URL inputs.
issues.fix_version: no fix available - migrate to axios or node-fetch

issues.title: Uncontrolled resource consumption in socket.io-parser
issues.description: Specially crafted packets can cause excessive memory usage leading to denial of service.

issues.title: Path Traversal in moment.js
issues.description: moment.locale() is vulnerable to path traversal attacks via user-controlled locale strings.

issues.title: Regular Expression Denial of Service in moment
issues.description: Inefficient regular expression complexity allowing an attacker to cause a denial of service.

issues.title: Prototype Pollution in minimist
issues.description: minimist before 1.2.6 is vulnerable to prototype pollution via the __proto__ key.

issues.title: Arbitrary Code Execution in PostgreSQL JDBC Driver
issues.description: pgjdbc can be vulnerable to loading arbitrary classes via attacker-controlled connection properties.

issues.title: Deep wrapper array nesting DoS in jackson-databind
issues.description: A deeply nested array causes stack overflow and resource exhaustion during deserialization.

issues.title: Spring Boot DoS via Spring MVC error handling
issues.description: An application using Spring MVC with Wildcard patterns is vulnerable to DoS attacks.

issues.title: Stack overflow in org.json JSON-Java library
issues.description: Converting a deeply nested JSON string to XML causes a stack overflow and application crash.

issues.title: Stack overflow in Woodstox XML library
issues.description: Parsing deeply nested XML documents causes stack overflow leading to application crash.

issues.title: Stack overflow via deeply nested JSON input in json-smart
issues.description: Parsing deeply nested JSON input causes uncontrolled recursion and a stack overflow crash.

issues.title: RCE via variable interpolation in Apache Commons Configuration
issues.description: Apache Commons Configuration 2.x allows attackers to perform RCE via crafted variable interpolation expressions.

issues.title: DoS via SniHandler in Netty
issues.description: If an SniHandler is a client connection is not closed after TLS handshake, resource exhaustion can occur.

issues.title: DoS via specially crafted SpEL expression
issues.description: Spring Framework allows crafted SpEL expressions to cause a denial of service condition.

issues.title: Denial of Service in SnakeYaml
issues.description: Parsing crafted YAML content can lead to a stack overflow in SnakeYaml before 1.32.

issues.title: Resource exhaustion via recursive data structures in jackson-databind
issues.description: Recursive data structures in deserialization can lead to excessive resource consumption.

issues.title: Arbitrary code execution via SnakeYaml Constructor
issues.description: SnakeYaml's Constructor class allows code execution when combined with specific Java types.

issues.title: DoS in Apache Commons FileUpload
issues.description: FileUpload does not limit the number of multipart form fields, allowing attackers to cause resource exhaustion.

issues.title: Regular Expression DoS in Pillow
issues.description: A crafted image file can cause excessive CPU consumption and denial of service.

issues.title: Uncontrolled resource consumption in Pillow via ImageFont
issues.description: ImageFont.getmask() can be exploited to cause excessive resource consumption via crafted input.

issues.title: Improper email address parsing in Python email module
issues.description: The email.utils module incorrectly handles edge cases in email parsing that can lead to false validation.

issues.title: Regular Expression Denial of Service in Python setuptools
issues.description: A crafted package version string can trigger excessive backtracking in the package_index module.

issues.title: Unintended redirect following with authentication header leak in requests
issues.description: The requests library forwards auth headers to third-party sites on redirect from HTTPS to HTTP.

issues.title: Removal of e-Tugra root certificate from certifi
issues.description: certifi contains a root certificate from e-Tugra which has been identified as compromised.

issues.title: Open redirect in oauthlib
issues.description: OAuthLib allows attackers to perform open redirect attacks via a specially crafted redirect_uri.

issues.title: Regular Expression Denial of Service in sqlparse
issues.description: A crafted SQL query can trigger exponential backtracking in sqlparse.

issues.title: Cookie request header leakage in urllib3
issues.description: urllib3 does not strip the Cookie header on cross-origin redirects, leaking credentials to untrusted hosts.

issues.title: Request body not stripped for HTTP redirect in urllib3
issues.description: urllib3 does not strip the request body on cross-scheme redirects from HTTPS to HTTP.

issues.title: Heap buffer overflow in libwebp via Pillow
issues.description: A heap buffer overflow in the WebP library affects image processing libraries including Pillow.

issues.title: Removal of TrustCor root certificates from certifi
issues.description: certifi contains root certificates from TrustCor which should no longer be trusted.

issues.title: ReDoS in cookiejar
issues.description: The ReDoS vulnerability in cookiejar allows attackers to cause denial of service via a crafted cookie string.

issues.title: Exposure of sensitive information in node-fetch
issues.description: node-fetch forwards headers on redirect to a different host that could expose auth tokens.

issues.title: Regular Expression Denial of Service in ansi-regex
issues.description: Inefficient regular expression complexity can allow an attacker to cause denial of service.

issues.title: npm pack publishes hidden files unintentionally
issues.description: npm pack and npm publish do not respect .npmignore for scoped packages correctly.

issues.title: Regular Expression Denial of Service in word-wrap
issues.description: An attacker can craft a payload that causes excessive backtracking in word-wrap.

issues.title: Regular Expression Denial of Service in terser
issues.description: The object property name RegEx in Terser can trigger ReDoS via crafted property names.

issues.title: Exposure of sensitive information in follow-redirects
issues.description: Sensitive HTTP headers are forwarded on cross-domain redirect, potentially leaking auth credentials.

issues.title: Prototype pollution in qs query parsing library
issues.description: Parsing malformed query strings allows prototype pollution in the resulting object.

issues.title: Prototype Pollution in json5
issues.description: An attacker can pollute Object.prototype via parse() with a crafted JSON5 string.

issues.title: Regular Expression Denial of Service in ua-parser-js
issues.description: Specially crafted User-Agent strings can cause excessive backtracking in ua-parser-js.

issues.title: Improper output neutralization in sudo
issues.description: sudoreplay does not properly escape terminal control characters, potentially causing display issues.

issues.title: Improper output neutralization for logs in sudo
issues.description: sudo before 1.9.13p2 does not escape terminal control characters written to the log file.

issues.title: Integer overflow in Jetty HTTP/2 header parsing
issues.description: HTTP/2 header parsing can trigger an integer overflow under specific conditions in Jetty.

issues.title: Information disclosure via WebSocket upgrade in Tomcat
issues.description: Mishandling of WebSocket upgrades may expose partial request details to subsequent connections.

issues.title: Open redirect in Vert.x Web
issues.description: StaticHandler in Vert.x Web can be exploited for open redirect via a crafted request URI.

issues.title: Potential DoS via multipart form data uploads in Django
issues.description: Django's multipart parser has a potential DoS vulnerability when processing specially crafted form data.
